items.title: Nvidia stock falls amid probe into CEO’s relationship with Chinese spy
items.summary:
“A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation,” Nvidia said in a Sunday statement. “The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders.”

An Nvidia spokesperson told NBC News that Huang was “committed to continuing to lead NVIDIA as CEO without interruption.” [...] Jensen Huang has become one of the main forces driving the global AI push while steering Nvidia to a market value of more than $4 trillion. Huang has led Nvidia since he founded it in 1993, so it would be a seismic change if he were to leave the role. [...] Nvidia’s peers, such as AMD, Qualcomm, Taiwan Semi and Intel, all rose along with the broader market. Nvidia was the biggest loser on the Dow, the Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500.

With so many outstanding questions about the Huang scandal, few major analysts that cover Nvidia had weighed in on Monday morning about what it could mean for the company’s future.

But those who did said it was a blemish on an otherwise sterling track record, which could spark even more investigations.

items.title: The 7 Essential Layers of AI Agent Architecture
items.summary:
The 7 Essential Layers of AI Agent Architecture

Building reliable AI agents requires more than LLMs and prompts.

Here are 7 layers every AI engineer should know.

01 - Models | Reasoning
Power decisions and tool selection.
GPT, Claude, Gemini, Mistral

02 - Vector DB | Retrieval
Enable semantic search and RAG.
Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Redis

03 - Frameworks | Integration
Connect models, data, and tools.
LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack

04 - Orchestration | Execution
Manage workflows, state, and retries.
LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK

05 - APIs & Protocols | Connectivity
Enable tool access and agent communication.
MCP, A2A, REST, JSON-RPC

06 - Infrastructure | Scaling
Handle deployment and compute.
Docker, Kubernetes, AWS ECS, Modal

07 - Evaluation | Reliability
Monitor accuracy, failures, latency, and cost.
RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse

Key Takeaway
A working agent needs intelligence.

A production-ready agent needs architecture, security, and continuous evaluation.

Which layer matters most in your AI projects?

items.summary:
Apple said in its annual financial filing on Tuesday that AI agents that can act in “unintended or unpredictable ways” could represent a threat to its business by opening the company up to lawsuits or hurting its reputation.

The new risk factors in Apple’s filing show the disruptive potential of AI agents, which have rapidly become top of mind for Silicon Valley’s most important companies. [...] “The Company’s ability to oversee and control third-party artificial intelligence agents and other technologies may be limited,” Apple warned in its filing.

Apple doesn’t currently have an agentic AI. But when new CEO John Ternus was asked on Monday’s earnings call about AI agents, he said that the company had “real room” to expand Siri’s capabilities. [...] “In addition, the Company is subject to the risks posed by ethical concerns and negative consumer perceptions related to automation, artificial intelligence and super intelligence, including perceived threats to safety or other societal harms or complications,” according to the filing.
